Use case: illustration-story. Queen's Trial production asset. Match the approved reference's soft hand-painted colored watercolor, delicate hand-drawn ink, granulated washes and antique gold/burgundy/indigo palette. No vector-like sharp facets, no digital 3D rendering, no text, no logo, no interface. The game is in a galaxy, no castle or terrestrial landscape.
Create a new widescreen 16:9 EDGE-TO-EDGE painted cosmic stage, ideally 2560x1440. This is the main menu background, NOT paper, NOT a book page: absolutely no ivory paper area, torn margins, frame, binding or border; paint dark space all the way to all four edges.
A vast indigo and muted plum galaxy, smoky watercolor nebulae, restrained copper and gold highlights and small distant stars. At lower center, a broken black-and-ivory marble CHESSBOARD arena floats among a few stone fragments, seen in perspective and small enough to leave the center readable. The arena extends along the bottom half only, roughly x=.25.. .73, y=.76..1.0.
Put ONE detailed, round rocky MOON at upper left, centered at normalized (.11,.26), radius .14 of image height. Keep it unobstructed and its circular rim clear, with subtle painted craters, antique cream-gray light and a soft indigo shadow. Put a SECOND small blue-and-gold Earth-like planet near normalized (.48,.87), radius .095 of image height, just beyond the arena's front edge: its round surface has organic watercolor land and clouds, no rings. Both planets are independent, clean circular silhouettes so the engine can animate the surfaces.
Reserve a broad quiet DARK indigo center, x=.23.. .69, y=.07.. .75, for the live large logo and menu words. Rich nebulae should be strongest at the sides and bottom, with only a few quiet stars in this middle space. No Queen, no traveler, no character of any kind: those will be separate animated layers. Convey a mysterious cosmic trial, a small arena against immense space. Painterly, refined, atmospheric, illuminated but not neon. Full landscape canvas, no blank outside margin.

Create ONE separate animated main-menu character layer: the exact Queen from the reference, a regal pale woman wearing the extraordinary broad golden many-eyed feather crown/headdress and the dark charcoal robe with fine gold jewelry. Preserve her particular face, the blue iris eyes on the golden feather fan, and the clothing design; NOT a chess queen.
A tall portrait canvas with her entire enormous crown, head, shoulders, torso and robe visible down to hip level. She turns gently in three-quarter view toward the VIEWER'S LEFT, looking down-left toward the traveler; quiet authoritative expression. Both natural arms can rest relaxed at her sides; no balance, no scales, no weapon. Lower robe and shoulder edges dissolve subtly into soft semi-transparent ink/watercolor feathering, WITHOUT a rectangular halo.
True transparent RGBA outside the Queen; absolutely no ivory paper, galaxy, planet, background wash field, platform or other character. Her eyes and the painted feather eyes stay crisply identifiable but softly painted, appropriate for gentle breathing motion. Center her in the portrait, keep the crown and limbs fully in frame with clean modest transparent margins. Thin ink, soft gold washes, natural watercolor pigment, no glossy CGI.

Whole figure, cape and platform in frame, with generous transparent margins around the flowing hem so its motion will not clip. Handmade watercolor, warm folds, thin subtle ink, not vector-sharp.
